subject: INLA encounters error while running in parallel after updating R studio

messages.author: 5b9f4f7553f48323
messages.subject: INLA encounters error while running in parallel after updating R studio
parts:
Hello,

I recently upgraded my R studio version to 3.3.1. I did not have any problem running INLA on parallel foreach loop before the update (I used library(INLA) and   INLA:::inla.dynload.workaround())
After updating R, I re-installed INLA but now I get the error -
 sh: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.3/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.static: No such file or directory

Error in { : 
  task 1 failed - "The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>."

Even without the foreach loop, I cannot run INLA at all. Do I need to revert back R version?
Could you please help me in fixing the error?

Thank you,
Sharmi

messages.author: 5b9f4f7553f48323
messages.subject: Re: INLA encounters error while running in parallel after updating R studio
parts:
Also I copied the inla.static exe file from linux to mac (random try, expected an error), and it gives me this error - 

sh: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.3/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.static: cannot execute binary file

Is the inla.static file missing from the mac 64 bit version?

Thank you,
Sharmi
